about: Cards every project starts with. `wf plan cards FILE.json` prepends these (in order, skipping any whose `if` flag is false or whose key the planner's file already uses) to the planner's milestones. `{{...}}` values are filled from the brief.

first.title: Scaffold the {{STACK_TITLE}} app with every gate green on the empty project
first.goal: A fresh clone installs, boots and passes `wf gates --release` with no pending gates.
acceptance: The app boots at {{DEV_URL}} from the documented install and dev commands
Every gate in .claude/workflow.json is installed and green; `pending` is removed from each (`wf plan unpend`)
Strictness flags from docs/ENGINEERING-STANDARDS.md stack rules are on, with zero baseline entries

first.title: Release gate script: one command that proves a commit is mergeable
first.goal: One project command (make ci / just ci / a script) runs the full gate set with pipefail and a log, and `release.cmd` in workflow.json points at it.
acceptance: The command exits non-zero when any gate fails or a required tool is missing (missing is never green)
It writes a log with the revision, each gate's exit code and timing

first.title: Design tokens, component catalog and the /dev/gallery page
first.goal: Tokens for colour, space, type and status in one file; CATALOG.md; a dev-only gallery that renders every component in every variant and state.
acceptance: Tokens cover colour (semantic and status), spacing, radius, type scale, line height and z-index, in light and dark
The tokens gate passes and fails on a planted hex colour
The gallery renders in {{WIDEST_LOCALE}} at 375 px and 1440 px with no clipping, verified by looking at the screenshots
The UI kit's known traps (docs/UI-UX-STANDARDS.md) are fixed in the generated primitives, including translated sr-only text

first.title: Auth{{#if multiTenant}} and tenancy{{/if}} skeleton with authorization and audit proven by tests
first.goal: Sign-in, roles and permissions{{#if multiTenant}}, tenant isolation (app scope + row-level security){{/if}} and the audit log, each enforced by a guard test.
acceptance: A route-table guard test fails when a state-changing route has no authorization
A refused user gets 403 on every state-changing route, child routes included
{{#if multiTenant}}A foreign tenant's rows are invisible and unwritable, proven per table{{/if}}
Every state change writes an append-only audit entry as {key, params}

first.title: First vertical slice: {{FIRST_JOB}}
first.goal: The first core job works end to end for a real user: data, rules, UI, i18n, tests and the audit trail.
acceptance: A user completes the job in the dev app; verified by looking in {{WIDEST_LOCALE}} at 375 px and 1440 px
Empty, loading, error and refused states are designed and shown
The list endpoint has a query-count test; the write has an authorization test
